name: BioEntry W3
tagLine: Outdoor-rated fingerprint reader for perimeter and gate access.
summary:
The BioEntry W3 is Suprema's IP65-rated outdoor fingerprint access reader, engineered to perform reliably in South Africa's harsh outdoor environments — from sun-baked factory gates to rain-exposed building perimeters. Featuring Suprema's proven fingerprint algorithm and support for Wiegand and OSDP output, it integrates with virtually any access control panel on the market.

Compact and vandal-resistant (IK09), the BioEntry W3 is the go-to choice for boom gates, turnstiles, car parks and secure facility perimeters where a ruggedised, standalone reader is required.

features.title: IP65 weatherproof
features.description: Fully dust-tight and protected against water jets — reliable in rain, dust and high UV environments.

features.title: IK09 vandal resistance
features.description: Reinforced housing withstands impact and attempted tampering at exposed outdoor installations.

features.title: Universal controller integration
features.description: Wiegand 26/34 and RS-485/OSDP outputs integrate with any third-party access controller.

features.title: Fast 1:N identification
features.description: Identifies users from a database of up to 100 000 fingerprints in under 1 second.
